capabilities: Show projects, milestones and GPT tasks in a dashboard with stat cards and tables
Create project, milestone and GPT task notes from forms
Edit status, progress, due dates and next actions in place
Move cards between status columns in a board view
Search, filter and export the visible rows to CSV
disambiguation: Not an AI tool: "GPT tasks" are ordinary notes in a folder and no model is called.
extras: Installed by copying built files into the vault's plugin folder rather than from the community list; the README states that touch dragging, CSV saving and Asana import on mobile are not verified.
intentEvidence: the Obsidian-native version of the Workroom dashboard
problem: Project status, milestones and GPT tasks sit in separate notes, so blocked, overdue or next-action items are hard to see in one place.

relations.evidence: the Obsidian-native version of the Workroom dashboard
Iconize integration requires Iconize to be installed and enabled on that device.
Use Import Asana on the dashboard or the Import Asana JSON into Milestones command.

summary: Dashboard that tracks projects, milestones and GPT tasks kept as frontmatter notes, with tables, a board view and inline editing.
